name: Resides In VPC
description: A VPC-scoped resource that is not placed in a subnet lives in a VPC (resource -> VPC): the item's VpcId. Security groups, network ACLs, route tables and target groups are VPC-wide; a gateway-type VPC endpoint has no subnet. A resource placed in subnets uses RESIDES_IN_SUBNET instead and reaches its VPC through the subnet, so the VPC is never recorded twice. A reference, not containment (containment edges must point parent -> child).
